component: EC165 Multilevel Inverter (N-level NPC / Cascaded H-Bridge)
description: Physics-lumped N-level inverter: staircase/PWM synthesis of a stepped sine with THD falling as levels rise; averaged LC output-filter ODE (solve_ivp); conduction+switching loss efficiency.

unit.name: Generic N-level NPC / CHB Inverter (50 kW, 700 V bus)
unit.source: Rodriguez, J., Lai, J.S., Peng, F.Z. (2002) IEEE Trans. Ind. Electron. 49(4) 724-738; Lai, J.S. & Peng, F.Z. (1996) IEEE Trans. Ind. Appl. 32(3) 509-517; Holmes & Lipo (2003) Pulse Width Modulation for Power Converters, Wiley.

V_dc.note: Total DC bus voltage (split across N-1 cells/capacitors)

n_levels.note: Number of output phase voltage levels (odd, >=2). 5-level default.

R_load.note: Resistive load per phase (sets ~50 kW 3ph at rated)

R_filter.note: Parasitic/damping series resistance of filter inductor

E_sw_ref.note: Combined turn-on+turn-off+recovery energy per switching event at V_ref,I_ref

V_ref.note: Reference blocking voltage for switching-energy scaling (per-cell V_dc/(N-1))
